units.locator: Article 23.81. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in Healthcare
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.81

units.locator: Article 23.81. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in Healthcare
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in healthcare and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.81

units.locator: Article 23.81. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in Healthcare
units.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in healthcare and their deputies.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.81

units.locator: Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order
units.text: Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order
units.label: Art. 23.82

units.locator: Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order
units.label: Art. 23.82

units.locator: Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of the state defence order shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 2 and 3 of Article 7.30.1 (with respect to violations relating to procurement under the state defence order, as well as violations relating to procurement for federal needs that is not part of the state defence order and information about which constitutes a state secret), parts 5 - 7 of Article 7.30.2 (with respect to violations relating to procurement under the state defence order, as well as violations relating to procurement for federal needs that is not part of the state defence order and information about which constitutes a state secret), parts 1 - 9, 11 - 13, 15 and 16 of Article 7.30.3, Article 7.32.6 (with respect to the state defence order), part 11 of Article 9.16 (with respect to the state defence order and state secrets), Article 15.14 (with respect to budget appropriations allocated for fulfilment of the state defence order), Article 19.4.2, part 7.1 of Article 19.5, and Article 19.7.2 (with respect to the state defence order and state secrets) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.82

units.locator: Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.82

units.locator: Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of the state defence order and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.82

units.locator: Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of the state defence order and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.82

units.locator: Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of the state defence order and their deputies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.82

units.text: 1. The federal executive authority authorised to exercise control in the sphere of procurement of goods, works and services by certain types of legal entities and its territorial authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 7.30.4 and part 7.2 of Article 19.5 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.83

units.locator: Article 23.83. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise Control in the Sphere of Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.83

units.locator: Article 23.83. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise Control in the Sphere of Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority authorised to exercise control in the sphere of procurement of goods, works and services by certain types of legal entities and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.83

units.locator: Article 23.83. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise Control in the Sphere of Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority authorised to exercise control in the sphere of procurement of goods, works and services by certain types of legal entities and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.83

units.locator: Article 23.83. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise Control in the Sphere of Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority authorised to exercise control in the sphere of procurement of goods, works and services by certain types of legal entities and their deputies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.83

units.locator: Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components
units.text: Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components
units.label: Art. 23.84

units.locator: Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising state control functions over ensuring the safety of donated blood and its components shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 6.31 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.84

units.locator: Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.84

units.locator: Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising state control functions over ensuring the safety of donated blood and its components and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.84

units.locator: Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising state control functions over ensuring the safety of donated blood and its components and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.84

units.locator: Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising state control functions over ensuring the safety of donated blood and its components and their deputies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.84

units.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation

units.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 23.85

units.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority performing functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 36 of Article 19.5, parts 1, 3, 4, 4.1, 5 and 6 of Article 20.8, Article 20.11, parts 1 - 3 of Article 20.12, Article 20.14, parts 1 and 2 - 4 of Article 20.16, part 1 of Article 20.23, and Article 20.24 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.85

units.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.85

units.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority performing functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.85

units.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority performing functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.85

units.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority performing functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.85

units.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority performing functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.85

units.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: 4.1) heads of extra-departmental security units of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
units.label: Point 4.1 Part 2 Art. 23.85

units.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation
units.text: 5) officials of the federal executive authority performing functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation and its territorial authorities who are authorised to exercise state control (supervision).
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.85

units.locator: Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners
units.text: Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners
units.label: Art. 23.86

units.locator: Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners
units.label: Art. 23.86

units.locator: Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising control (supervision) functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of insolvency practitioners shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 6 and 7 of Article 14.25, Article 14.52 (where those offences are committed by self-regulatory organisations of insolvency practitioners), Article 14.52.1, and part 29 of Article 19.5 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.86

units.locator: Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the federal executive authority exercising control (supervision) functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of insolvency practitioners:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.86

units.locator: Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising control (supervision) functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of insolvency practitioners and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.86

units.locator: Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising control (supervision) functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of insolvency practitioners and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.86

units.locator: Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control (supervision) functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of insolvency practitioners and their deputies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.86

units.locator: Article 23.87. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Implement State Policy in the Sphere of Heat Supply

units.locator: Article 23.87. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Implement State Policy in the Sphere of Heat Supply
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.87. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Implement State Policy in the Sphere of Heat Supply
units.label: Art. 23.87

units.locator: Article 23.87. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Implement State Policy in the Sphere of Heat Supply
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority authorised to implement state policy in the sphere of heat supply shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 5 of Article 9.24 and parts 34 and 35 of Article 19.5 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.87

units.locator: Article 23.87. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Implement State Policy in the Sphere of Heat Supply
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.87

units.locator: Article 23.87. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Implement State Policy in the Sphere of Heat Supply
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority authorised to implement state policy in the sphere of heat supply and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.87

units.locator: Article 23.87. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Implement State Policy in the Sphere of Heat Supply
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority authorised to implement state policy in the sphere of heat supply and their deputies.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.87

units.locator: Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 23.88

units.locator: Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 23.88

units.locator: Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. Military police authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 6.24, parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.20, and Article 20.21 of this Code in relation to service members of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation and citizens called up for military training in the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, as well as civilian personnel of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation where they commit administrative offences within the territories of military units or in connection with the performance of official duties.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.88

units.locator: Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of military police authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.88

units.locator: Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1) the head of the central military police authority of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, his or her deputies and heads of structural divisions of the central military police authority of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.88

units.locator: Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2) heads of regional military police authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, their deputies and heads of structural divisions of regional military police authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.88

units.locator: Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3) heads of territorial military police authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, their deputies and heads of structural divisions of territorial military police authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.88

units.locator: Article 23.89. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Social Services
units.text: Article 23.89. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Social Services

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.89. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Social Services
units.label: Art. 23.89

units.locator: Article 23.89. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Social Services
units.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the sphere of social services shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 9.13 (with respect to evasion of compliance with requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of social service facilities and services provided in the sphere of social services) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.89

units.locator: Article 23.89. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Social Services
units.text: 2. Heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the sphere of social services and their deputies shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.89

units.locator: Article 23.90. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Security of the Critical Information Infrastructure of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 23.90. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Security of the Critical Information Infrastructure of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 23.90

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.90. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Security of the Critical Information Infrastructure of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 23.90

units.locator: Article 23.90. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Security of the Critical Information Infrastructure of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority authorised in the field of ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 13.12.1 and parts 1 and 3 of Article 19.7.15 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.90

units.locator: Article 23.90. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Security of the Critical Information Infrastructure of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. The head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of that federal executive authority, their deputies, heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority, their deputies, and heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.90
